features.title: Tauri 2 + React + FastAPI sidecar skeleton with session-token auth
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app starts, launches the Python backend on a random localhost port, and the frontend can call an authenticated /health endpoint.
verification: uv run pytest passes in /backend.
npm run build succeeds in the frontend.
cargo check succeeds in /src-tauri.
Backend rejects requests without the session token (covered by tests).
evidence: 2026-10-28: ./init.sh full run passed end to end: ruff clean, uv run pytest 8 passed (session 002, PROGRESS.md), tsc && vite build ok, cargo check ok.

features.title: Gmail draft creation via OAuth2 (PKCE), direct send behind a setting
features.user_visible_behavior: The user connects Gmail and approved applications are created as drafts in their mailbox; direct send exists but is opt-in.
verification: OAuth2 (PKCE) flow works against mocked Gmail endpoints in tests.
Draft creation is the default; direct send requires the explicit setting and a confirmation click.
Tokens are stored in the OS keychain only.
evidence: 2026-10-28: tests/test_mail.py: PKCE authorize URL carries S256 code_challenge (verifier never in the URL); token exchange posts the code_verifier; connect flow against mocked endpoints stores access/refresh tokens in the (memory) keychain with raw tokens asserted absent from the SQLite file; forged state rejected.

2026-10-28: deliver() is the single gateway: draft mode requires confirm=true (422 otherwise); direct send requires allow_direct_send=true AND confirm=true (blocked 422 with clear message otherwise, nothing sent); draft mode posts base64url MIME to /drafts, send posts to /messages/send; statuses draft_saved / sent with sent_at and EventLog draft_created/sent; daily_send_limit enforced (422 'limit' after N sends today).
2026-10-28: unconnected Gmail produces a clear 422 error; mail settings persist in the appsetting table (migration b2f000000002, upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade verified).
2026-10-28: ./init.sh full run passed (ruff, pytest 82 passed, tsc+vite build, cargo check).

2026-10-28: UI: Settings Mail section (OAuth2 connect with code paste, allow-direct-send opt-in, daily limit, sender email); Review screen final confirmation dialog (recipient, subject, letter size, attachments, draft default, send disabled unless enabled).
